verdict.rationale: Omnara does not ship a dedicated insights feature. You can approximate one by configuring your own agent: connect MCP servers or custom tools for access to your data, attach documents to a conversation, and chat with the agent in the dashboard or Slack, where it can analyze that data and suggest next steps. Missing for 10: a built-in, out-of-the-box feature that generates insights or suggestions from your data, documentation of any analysis or insight capability beyond general agent chat, and independent hands-on corroboration.
